scientific_integrity: Every all-graph assertion is proved using elementary exchange/cut arguments and classical matching, spanning-tree-packing and arboricity theorems. Finite independently specified enumeration corroborates rather than substitutes for infinite proofs. An independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs, ordinary basic nonadaptive teaching of a specified spanning tree by positive/negative edge-incidence labels; weighted costs are nonnegative. The result does not cover adaptive, recursive or no-clash teaching, or uncertain numerical edge weights. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Teaching spanning trees by edge labels: exchange covers and two sharp global thresholds
